messages:
maya: AlderBank just flagged repeated p95 timeouts from their dedicated pool since the last canary. CS says SLA window at risk. Anyone owning dedicated routing right now?

ops-bot: alert ticket #INC-8742 created by monitoring (severity: high)

ashwin: I'll take a first pass, pulling logs now. what time did they start seeing it?

maya: ~ 07:12 UTC, spike started with canary rollout at 07:05

dani: I'm on dedicated-pool. Jumping in — can you get a trace ID or request IDs from CS? I'll check KV-cache pressure and continuous batching settings.

emma-cs: sending sample request ids: req_9f3a, req_9f3b, req_9f3c. Customer is on committed pool 'alder-dedicated-2'.

ashwin: seeing elevated tail latency on GPU node gpu-pool-12, threads getting stuck on KV lock for long seqs. Attaching snippet:

```
[2026-03-18T07:14:22Z] WARN kv_cache: lock_wait=352ms key=prefix:user:... node=gpu-pool-12
[2026-03-18T07:14:23Z] ERROR runtime: inference_hang pid=12947 model=opt-30b quant=8bit
```

kevin: there's an open canary-rewrite PR that changed KV lock behavior — PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4823 (draft). Looks related.

dani: If PR is the culprit, we should either rollback or isolate the change for alder-dedicated. Quick plan: 1) enable routing fallback to hosted model for AlderBank for 30m, 2) pin alder-dedicated to previous model runtime, 3) roll back canary in infra.

maya: Owners? ashwin -> logs + rollback PR? dani -> routing fallback + pin? kevin -> ready to revert or patch PR. tara -> can you review the rollback PR?

tara: I can review in ~20m. If you need emergency review ping me @tara.

dani: Running command to set fallback (will run in 2m):

```
redwoodctl route update --customer alderbank --policy fallback-hosted --duration 30m --reason "Dedicated latency spike post-canary"
```

dani: done — route change applied, traffic shifting to hosted variant for matching endpoints. Monitor should reflect drop.

ashwin: after fallback, p95 for AlderBank dropped from 1.9s to 380ms within ~45s. Node gpu-pool-12 still shows KV lock waits but load decreased.

kevin: opened rollback PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4827 — includes revert of KV-change. tagging @t tara for review.

tara: Reviewing now. Quick note: ensure we don't break compatibility with small-sequence runs.

maya: CS update: Emma relayed to AlderBank; they can accept 30m fallback. Good.

emma-cs: confirmed; customer appreciated quick update. They'll hold off exposing traffic spike for now.

dani: After rollback merged and deployed, we'll re-run canary with conservative concurrency. Ashwin can you validate KV-wait histograms and add a short-runbook item?

ashwin: yes, I'll validate and post graphs in this thread within 30m.

kevin: rolled back internally in canary cluster — deployment in progress (deploy-bot status: in-progress)

deploy-bot: deployment infra/canary-svc reverted, started 07:28 UTC, status: success

ops-bot: monitoring: p95 for AlderBank stable at 350ms for past 10m

maya: action items: 1) kevin merge + deploy rollback (done) 2) ashwin post KV histograms 3) dani add pin+runbook 4) tara followup CR notes 5) postmortem with infra & oncall tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Who will own postmortem?

dani: I'll own the postmortem and coordinate with infra. Adding agenda.

tara: I'll draft CR notes, add to rollback PR.

ashwin: graphs posted: https://internal/graphs/kv-locks/alderbank-03-18.png

maya: thanks all. I'll close the incident once CS confirms no regression for next 24h. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident INC-8742 status: monitoring -> stable
